This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Japan’s paratrooper rifle that splits in half: the Arisaka Type 2 broke into two pieces for combat jumps, then reassembled on the ground—even in the dark. About 21,000 made; fought in the 1944 Philippines jump. Why didn’t more armies copy this?
